# Web-Tools
> An exhaustive, research-backed directory compiling essential developer utilities, IDEs, AI coding assistants, free CS certifications, UI inspiration, typography, and student perks.

## Main Links
- Homepage & Directory: https://web-tools.kidlat.workers.dev/
- Creator Portfolio: https://portfolio.kidlat.workers.dev/
- GitHub Repository: https://github.com/kidlatpogi/Web-tools

## Curated Domains
- IDEs & Code Editors (Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, Zed, Neovim)
- AI Agents & Coding Assistants (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Manus AI, Google AI Studio)
- AI Chatbots & Models (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Perplexity, Kimi AI)
- Design Inspiration & UI Tools (Mobbin, Godly, Shadcn UI, React Bits, Laws of UX)
- Free Certifications & Courses (Cisco NetAcad, freeCodeCamp, Harvard CS50, IBM SkillsBuild)
- Fonts, Logos & Design Assets (Google Fonts, Fontshare, Fonts In Use, Coolors, SVGL)
- Student Perks & Free Tiers (GitHub Student Developer Pack, Google One, Supabase)
- Online Tools & Utilities (iLovePDF, Figma, Canva, Draw.io, Excalidraw, DevDocs, Regex101, Transform.tools)
